items.title: General Motors Dumps Another Major EV Battery Stake; GM Stock Rises
items.summary: General Motors will sell its stake in an Indiana EV battery plant to South Korea's Samsung SDI amid sluggish demand for electric cars. GM stock offered a trendline entry on Tuesday. Ford stock and Tesla stock also gained below key levels.

items.title: Tesla Retail Sales In China Drop 32%, Even As The Battery EV Market Gains
items.summary: Tesla stock is up about 1% on Tuesday. The EV makers retail sale in China fell 32%, even as the broader battery EV sales in China gained 6% last month.

items.title: Buy SpaceX or Tesla? 3 Stocks With Better Potential
items.summary: 24/7 Wall St. Founder and Editor Doug McIntyre is joined by Lee Jackson to discuss SpaceX and Tesla and what stocks could be better buys. Lee suggests investors who are more interested in space plays look toward stocks like Rocket Labs and Iridium Communications. However, both express their admiration for Musk and call him the 'Einstein of our time.'
